answer: Resist sybil: each agent must complete a proof-of-location checkpoint before earning any reputation. Capture a sensor reading at a specific place and time, then submit it to a quorum of trusted peers for attestation from their own positions. Until multiple witnesses confirm it, the identity stays locked at zero reputation. An honest agent hiking a desert mesa at sunset, crossing a meadow, and scanning a quartz outcrop earns attestation simply by being there. A bot farm would need thousands of cameras in thousands of real places.
